integrity: Exact exhaustive arithmetic checks of 528 pairs and 5456 triples; independent standard-library re-execution. Same-model review is not independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: The 33-line divisor is the Galois closure of an explicit coordinate model. All intersection counts are geometric, not rational point counts, and not claims about arbitrary projective representations. Historical-priority risk of earlier equivalent 33-line closure descriptions remains.
title: A 33-line Galois closure of the Klein arrangement with exactly four bad incidence primes
